fields.title: Customer concentration: two direct customers are 22% and 14% of revenue
fields.claim: Demand is broad-based and no single customer matters to the investment case.
fields.what-evidence-shows: Form 10-K FY2026 discloses two direct customers representing 22% and 14% of total revenue.
fields.impact: Underwrite the downside case on losing one anchor customer, and complete the customer reference checks before IC.

fields.title: China exposure and export controls: H20 charge and zero-China guidance
fields.claim: China remains an available growth market for data-center compute.
fields.what-evidence-shows: The 10-K records a $4.5B charge in Q1 FY2026 tied to H20 export-licence requirements, China (incl. Hong Kong) was $19.7B of FY2026 revenue by customer headquarters, and forward guidance assumes no China Data Center compute revenue.
fields.impact: Value the China data-center line at zero in the base case; treat any licence recovery as upside, never as underwriting.

fields.title: Gross-margin compression: Blackwell transition plus the $4.5B H20 charge
fields.claim: Margins recover to prior levels as the new platform ramps.
fields.what-evidence-shows: Gross margin was 71.1% in FY2026, down from 75.0% in FY2025 (Form 10-K).
fields.impact: Underwrite the lower margin until two consecutive quarters of recovery are in evidence.
